body:
CONTEXT
ROADMAP.md step 0 matrix, L35-47 (verbatim): "- scope: working-tree, branch / - providers: single API, single CLI, multi-provider (2 families, quorum 1 and 2) / - flags: --verify on/off, --passes 1/2, --json on/off / - inputs: empty scope (with and without --fail-on-empty), oversized diff (API fails closed, CLI gets summary, --allow-summary-review), payload containing a secret (with and without --allow-secrets), reviewer output containing a secret (redacted) / - failures: one provider fails in multi-provider (skipped + under-satisfied notice), all fail (exit 1), malformed model JSON (one corrective retry, then exit 1) / ... / - exit codes for every row above". --input, L57-61: "As today, an unreadable, binary, oversized, or empty artifact exits 1, and an artifact context never takes the summary path. Step 0 parity rows for `--input`: single API provider, single CLI provider, multi-provider, a missing file (exit 1), an empty file (exit 1), a file over `--max-bytes` (exit 1), and a run from a non-git directory." A10 L805: "A parity row covers `--input --verify` with a mock verifier." L145-147: rows assert ONLY v2.11.0 behavior; nothing here tests a delta. These rows are the RAILS for step 1 (C2/C1 must pass them with zero edits, L1361-1363); every later delta edits only the rows whose manifest futureDeltas list it.

Code under test (read, do not modify): bin/cli.js main() ~L250-433 (collection ~L300-315, prompt L318-320, empty exit L322-336, secret scan L338-352, single path ~L368-432, scrubResult L190-200), runMultiProvider L31-177 (unreachable ~L40-46, API drop on non-inlinable ~L54-61, failures skipped ~L74-80, verify ~L81-93, under-satisfied notice ~L101-107, synthesized summary ~L135-140, exit L176), summaryOnlyGuardError ~L223-231; src/review.js runReviewOnce ~L462-505 (corrective retry), deriveQuorumVerdict ~L652, resolveReachableProviders ~L721, verifyFindings ~L807; src/llm.js resolveProviderToken ~L1708-1760 (FAMILY_CANDIDATES order: API key, gateway, CLI), CLI retry paths (T50 item 5a); src/artifact-context.js.

HARNESS CONTRACT (from T50) THESE ROWS DEPEND ON
- Each file calls defineRows('<stem>') and registers every row with row(id, title, fn); ids live in test/parity/rows/<stem>.json with { roadmapRef, futureDeltas }.
- A failing claude/codex reviewer is invoked TWICE (stdin, then argv retry; src/llm.js L1180-1186 and L551-561): script failTwice(...) and assert 2 invocations; pinned stderr comes from the second attempt.
- Unexpected stub requests get 418 (non-retryable). A row that wants an API failure queues an explicit 4xx (e.g. 400 'parity-stub: bad request') so no retries occur.
- withMutant requires a unique `find`.

PROVIDER FIXTURES (fixed for every row)
- single API: `--provider anthropic`, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dummy, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=stub.
- single CLI: `--provider claude` with the claude mock.
- multi (2 families): `--providers anthropic,openai` with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY+stub (anthropic API) and NO OpenAI key, codex mock on PATH (resolves to cli codex per FAMILY_CANDIDATES), at `--quorum 1` and `--quorum 2`. Assert stderr contains `Multi-provider review: anthropic[anthropic], openai[openai]` (bin/cli.js ~L63) - confirm the exact bracket labels from a run.
- Responses: FLAG = one high/0.9 finding citing a changed line of code.js with evidence quoting that line verbatim (grounding passes); APPROVE = no findings. Verify replies: not-refuted unless stated.

ROW IDS (each registered with row(); every id in the file's manifest)
A. Matrix (nonloop-matrix.test.mjs), table-driven: NL-M-<scope>-<prov>-v<0|1>-p<1|2>-j<0|1> for scope in {wt, br} x prov in {api, cli, multi-q1, multi-q2} x verify x passes x json = 64 rows, all FLAG from every reviewer -> exit 2. Plus NL-M-APPROVE-<scope>-<prov> (8 rows, APPROVE, --json) -> exit 0, verdict approve. Plus NL-M-Q2-SPLIT-<scope> (multi q2, one provider FLAG, one APPROVE) -> exit 0 (deriveQuorumVerdict) and NL-M-Q1-SPLIT-<scope> -> exit 2.
   Per row assert: exit code; with --json: stdout parses, assertValidOutput passes, `verdict` matches the exit code; single mode: `summary` equals the model's own summary and NO finding has `corroborated_by`; multi mode: every finding has `corroborated_by` and `summary` is the synthesized quorum text (bin/cli.js ~L136-140) (L956-962 pins this SINGLE vs MULTI distinction); without --json: stdout is the human report (contains the finding title, does not parse as JSON); review-call count = passes per reviewer and, with --verify, verify-call count = findings sent to verify (isVerifyPrompt/isReviewPrompt); stub.unexpected empty.
B. Inputs (nonloop-inputs.test.mjs):
   NL-EMPTY-<scope> / NL-EMPTY-FOE-<scope>: empty scope -> exit 0 with stderr 'Nothing to review' and the 'pass --fail-on-empty' hint; with --fail-on-empty -> exit 1 with stderr '(--fail-on-empty set)'; both: stdout empty, zero provider calls.
   NL-BIG-API: diff larger than `--max-bytes 64` with single API -> exit 1, stderr contains 'too large to inline', zero stub requests.
   NL-BIG-CLI: same diff, single CLI -> proceeds; stderr contains 'mode: summary'; exit by verdict.
   NL-BIG-API-ALLOW: single API + --allow-summary-review -> one stub request, exit by verdict.
   NL-BIG-MULTI: multi with the large diff -> pin which providers were called and the stderr notice as resolveReachableProviders does today; exit by verdict.
   NL-SECRET-<scope>: diff contains `AKIA` + 16 uppercase/digit chars -> exit 1, stderr 'Possible secret in review payload' and 'Refusing to send', stdout empty, zero calls.
   NL-SECRET-ALLOW-<scope>: same with --allow-secrets -> proceeds, exit by verdict.
   NL-REVOUT-SECRET-j<0|1>: diff clean, reviewer FLAG finding body contains an `sk-` + 24-char token -> stdout does NOT contain the token and DOES contain the masked form produced by src/secrets.js redact() (match by regex copied from a v2.11.0 run); stderr 'Redacted likely secret(s) from the review output'.
C. Failures (nonloop-failures.test.mjs):
   NL-MULTI-ONEFAIL-q1 / NL-MULTI-ONEFAIL-q2 (q2 named in R5 L616-618): codex mock failTwice({stderr:'boom', exit:1}), anthropic FLAG, --json -> exactly 2 codex invocations, stderr 'Provider openai failed and was skipped' and the under-satisfied notice; exit 2 for q1; for q2 pin the v2.11.0 value observed in a run (expected 2: effective quorum capped at successful providers).
   NL-MULTI-ALLFAIL: --json; anthropic stub replies 400 'parity-stub: bad request' (one request, no retry), codex failTwice -> exit 1, stderr 'All selected providers failed', stdout empty.
   NL-MALFORMED-RECOVER-<api|cli>: first reply non-JSON prose, second FLAG -> exit 2, exactly 2 review calls, second prompt carries the corrective feedback (runReviewOnce).
   NL-MALFORMED-FAIL-<api|cli>: two non-JSON replies -> exit 1, stderr 'Model output failed after a corrective retry', exactly 2 calls, stdout empty under --json.
D. --input (input-artifact.test.mjs), artifact = docs/spec.md text file:
   NL-IN-API, NL-IN-CLI, NL-IN-MULTI: exit by verdict; the prompt received (stdin / stub body) contains the artifact text and no `diff --git` header; assertValidOutput under --json.
   NL-IN-MISSING: nonexistent path -> exit 1, stdout empty, zero calls.
   NL-IN-EMPTY: zero-byte file -> exit 1, zero calls.
   NL-IN-OVERSIZE: file larger than --max-bytes -> exit 1 (never the summary path), zero calls.
   NL-IN-NONGIT: cwd is a non-git temp dir (makePlainDir) containing the artifact -> review runs, exit by verdict.
   NL-IN-VERIFY: `--input <file> --verify --provider claude` with FLAG review then a not-refuted verify reply -> exit 2, one review call then one verify call. Assert only outcome and call counts, NOT verify-prompt wording.
E. Usage errors (usage-errors.test.mjs; ROADMAP step 0 matrix 'usage errors (v59, delta 28 kept)' and Intended deltas 28: "pinned by three step 0 parity rows ... land in step 0 and no row is edited for it"). v2.11.0 src/utils.js L477-479 pushes `--model cannot be combined with --providers; ...`. Each row: exit 1, stdout empty, stderr contains `--model cannot be combined with --providers`, zero mock invocations (probes included) and zero stub requests; substring checks only (assertStderrIncludes), so no 36.
   USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-SINGLE: `--model x --providers openai`.
   USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-LIST: `--model x --providers openai,anthropic`.
   USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-AUTO: `--model x --providers auto`.
   USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-SYNONYM: `--model x --providers openai,gpt` (synonyms; still rejected, decisions Q1).
   USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDER-OK (negative control, ROADMAP delta 28 text): `--model x --provider openai --prompt-only` -> exit 0, stdout is the prompt, stderr does not contain `cannot be combined`.
   futureDeltas [1] for the four error rows (SINGLE, LIST, SYNONYM, AUTO). The -OK control row lists [9] only: it is a working-tree --prompt-only run, so R1 never applies to it (decision B1, so no delta 1) and delta 9 changes its printed prompt (delta 1 adds `--builder human`); NEVER 28 (T50 rejects it).

FUTURE DELTAS (manifest futureDeltas; ids from the T50 delta registry, test/parity/helpers/deltas.mjs, which lists every intended delta 1-38 from day one)
- Every row: 1 (delta 1 adds `--builder human` to every row's invocation, L1350-1355).
- Every --json row: 8 (meta on emitted JSON). Non-json rows do NOT list 8.
- Every multi row: 12 (stderr progress order); and rows with --providers and multiple passes may be affected by 28 only if they pass --model (none do; do not list 28).
- Rows with --verify: 15. NL-REVOUT-SECRET-*: 16. NL-SECRET-*, NL-SECRET-ALLOW-*: 17. Payload deltas (T50 AP1 and AP3: `prompts` and `requests` are compared fields, so a row is tagged whenever a delta changes what it SENDS, whether or not it asserts on it): 9 on every working-tree row that reaches a provider (the payload becomes one combined diff), and also on working-tree --prompt-only rows (the printed prompt changes); 14 on every row with at least one stub request (native structured-output API calls drop the schema from the system instruction); 31 on every row that reaches any provider, mock CLI or stub (the schema text loses $schema/$id/$comment), but NOT on --prompt-only rows (their stdout is the user prompt only, bin/cli.js `if (args.promptOnly)`, while the schema lives in the system instruction); 29 on --input rows run with --verify (the verify prompt's wording). NL-MULTI-ONEFAIL-q2 and NL-MULTI-ALLFAIL: 19 (after step 3 all-providers-failing and under-quorum yield the quorum-unmet error object, R5 L606-612, L1197-1200). NL-IN-VERIFY: 29 (and every other --input --verify row, per the payload rule). NL-BIG-*: 5 only for working-tree rows with untracked bytes (none: do not list).

- DELTA TAGS FOR v59 DELTAS (T50 registry, test/parity/helpers/deltas.mjs; tag semantics T50 item 9b): ids come from the registry T50 lands on day one (1-37, withdrawn ids rejected). Never 28 or 37: both are UNTAGGABLE (28 pins v2.11.0 behavior; J9.4 forbids any existing row listing 37), and the T50 checks reject them. 34 and 35: not for the additive loop_summary keys meta.thrash and meta.rotation:null, which are the T50 envelopes of those deltas. 36: only for a row that asserts stderr EXACTLY (equality, emptiness) on a detecting run, which must use assertStderrExact; the T50 helper throws until such a row lists 36, so the tag cannot be forgotten. Substring checks (assertStderrIncludes / assertStderrExcludes) need no 36: the one-line hint is the delta-36 envelope. 32 and 33: only if the row's invocation is one delta 32 rejects, or its pinned CLI retry timing is one delta 33 changes (none planned; T91 adds its own CLIERR-UNIT-BUDGET row). T52 rows do not run --loop, so 34 and 35 never apply; AC5 keeps every stderr check a substring check, so no T52 row lists 36.

BASELINE: rows pin what release 2.11.1 emits. 2.11.1 is v2.11.0 plus the #66 status-path fix, so every "v2.11.0" behavior cited here holds, except that a FLAG finding on an unstaged first-status file now gates normally. Cited line numbers are approximate; locate code by symbol. Cite the ROADMAP by section heading. All rows use the T50 harness and its approved spec (.adlc/specs/T50.md): rows are registered via defineRows, captures include prompts and requests (T50 AP1), tags follow T50 9b and AP3, every non-loop --json output goes through assertValidOutput and every loop line through assertValidEvents (T51).

DECISIONS (P0, 2026-10-06)
- NL-IN-BINARY: `--input` of a file containing NUL bytes -> exit 1, stderr names the file as binary, zero provider calls. NL-IN-UNREADABLE: `--input` of a chmod 000 file -> exit 1, stderr names the file as unreadable, zero provider calls; the row is skipped when process.getuid() === 0 (root can read it), with that reason. Both go in input-artifact.test.mjs.
- USAGE-LOOP-INPUT (input-artifact.test.mjs): `--loop --loop-unsafe --json --provider claude --input <file outside the repo>` -> exit 1, stdout empty, stderr contains `--input cannot be combined with --loop`, zero non-probe mock invocations and zero stub requests. futureDeltas [] (it never changes: 2.11.1 already rejects the combination at src/utils.js `parseArgs`, so delta 30 is already satisfied; T74 only verifies this row stays green). It runs pre-resolution, so any exact-stderr assertion declares `preResolution: 'usage error'`.
- The non-loop matrix is the full 64-row cartesian product, table-driven, in nonloop-matrix.test.mjs.
- The delta-28 usage rows (USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-SINGLE, -LIST, -SYNONYM, -AUTO and the -OK control) belong to this ticket. T80 only migrates them to --builder human.

MANIFEST FIELD: per T50 item 9, each manifest entry is { roadmapRef, futureDeltas }, where roadmapRef is a ROADMAP section HEADING string (for example "Step 0. Parity suite"), never a line number.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
AC1  Every row id in A-E is registered via row() and present in the corresponding test/parity/rows/<stem>.json with roadmapRef and futureDeltas per the FUTURE DELTAS list. Verified by the T50 registry after() hooks and the manifest checks in `node --test test/parity/harness.test.mjs`, plus a test in nonloop-failures.test.mjs asserting NL-MULTI-ALLFAIL and NL-MULTI-ONEFAIL-q2 list 19, no non-json row lists 8, no T52 row lists 34, 35 or 36, and the four usage-errors.test.mjs error rows (SINGLE, LIST, SYNONYM, AUTO) list exactly [1] and USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDER-OK lists exactly [9] (negative controls: the same assertion function reports an injected manifest row listing 36, and an injected USAGE-MODEL-PROVIDERS-SINGLE listing [1, 28] is rejected by the T50 tag check as untaggable).
AC2  All rows pass against unmodified v2.11.0. Verified by `node --test test/parity/nonloop-matrix.test.mjs test/parity/nonloop-inputs.test.mjs test/parity/nonloop-failures.test.mjs test/parity/input-artifact.test.mjs test/parity/usage-errors.test.mjs`.
AC3  Every --json row calls assertValidOutput on stdout when non-empty, and every row asserts stub.unexpected is empty. Verified by AC2 plus `grep -c assertValidOutput test/parity/nonloop-*.test.mjs test/parity/input-artifact.test.mjs` non-zero per file.
AC4  Negative controls via withMutant (unique find strings), each asserting the targeted row's assertions FAIL (assert.rejects) on the mutant: (a) bin/cli.js find `if (!args.promptOnly && !args.allowSecrets) {` replace `if (false) {` -> NL-SECRET-wt fails; (b) `function summaryOnlyGuardError(` body made to return null (find the full first line plus its first statement) -> NL-BIG-API fails; (c) drop the `merged.summary =` synthesis -> a multi --json row fails; (d) scrubResult body replaced with `return result;` (find from `function scrubResult(result) {` through its first line) -> NL-REVOUT-SECRET-j1 fails. Each find string is verified unique by withMutant itself. Verified in `[row:NEG-NL-*]` rows in nonloop-failures.test.mjs.
AC5  No timing- or order-dependent assertion on stderr (delta 12 makes progress order nondeterministic, L1316-1317): stderr checks are substring presence/absence only. Verified by P5 hollow-test review and AC6.
AC6  Determinism: `for i in 1 2 3; do node --test test/parity/*.test.mjs || exit 1; done` passes (a shell glob of files: since Node 21 a bare directory argument to `node --test` is treated as a file and fails).
AC7  No production or rail change: `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers test/parity/harness.test.mjs test/parity/schemas.test.mjs` empty. Verified by that command and rails-guard.

NON-GOALS
- No precedence/stage-order, CLI-error, or cache/fallback rows (T53). No loop rows (T54).
- No assertion on prompt wording, schema text inside prompts, or exact payload format (deltas 9, 14, 29, 31 change those).
- No delta behavior (no --builder, no meta, no quorum-unmet).

VERIFICATION COMMAND
node --test test/parity/*.test.mjs && npm test && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers
title: Parity rows: non-loop matrix, inputs, failures, and --input artifact rows against 2.11.1 (ROADMAP step 0)
